name: Protected-Certificate Depth Remains Unbounded on Reduced Terminal Inputs
scope: Ample pc-minimal obstructions to dismantlable ampleness whose every one-coordinate reduction peels, whose minimum graph degree is at least three, and whose signed minimal-nonface columns are distinct up to sign.
proof: The terminal construction again provides a $2^m-1$ tip-fibre deletion branch whose every stage has empty protected core. Frozen missing-cube witnesses exclude old-factor first moves, while the filled root cube controls mixed vertices and the root. The same family is reduction-terminal and fixed by graph-core and column-compression reductions, so these canonical simplifications do not bound the certificate depth.
